name: Why would my brand-new water heater's pilot light go out?

mainEntity.name: Why would my brand-new water heater's pilot light go out?

acceptedAnswer.text: Even new water heaters can experience pilot light issues, though it's less common. This could be due to a manufacturing defect in the thermocouple or gas control valve, or perhaps an issue during installation, such as a kinked pilot tube or improper gas pressure settings. Sometimes, drafts in the utility area can also affect new installations. If your brand-new water heater's pilot light repeatedly goes out, it's important to contact the installer or manufacturer promptly, as it's likely covered under warranty.
acceptedAnswer.description: A new water heater's pilot light might go out due to a manufacturing defect, installation issues, or drafts. Contact the installer or manufacturer.
